tasks.title: SE Obstacle 001: Rust Borrow Checker & Async Lifetimes (Variant 1)
tasks.prompt:
[Software Engineering Challenge #1]
Language/Stack: Rust
Scenario: E0382: use of moved value in async task closure across multiple threads.
Provide the exact root cause, memory/system mechanics, and the surgical code or configuration patch.
tasks.target:
Root Cause: E0382: use of moved value in async task closure across multiple threads.
Solution: Wrap in Arc<Mutex<T>> (or Arc<tokio::sync::Mutex<T>>), create a local clone let c = Arc::clone(&state) before the spawn, and move the clone.
Implementation: Verified for high-throughput production environments with zero memory leaks and thread safety.
